intro: We help international companies plan, structure and launch their Brazilian operations with confidence, strategy and expert guidance.
heroNote: International perspective. Local knowledge. One partner.
problemTitle: Entering a new market should not mean facing it alone.
problemText: Legal, cultural, financial and administrative differences make entering Brazil complex. With guidance, every challenge becomes a clear step.
valueTitle: You know your business. Nordion knows Brazil.
valueText: We connect these two realities to develop a tailored plan for entering and expanding in Brazil.
valueQuote: How does Brazil apply to your business?
processTitle: A new market. A clear path.
processText: We understand the business, interpret the Brazilian environment and connect the required specialists.
steps: We analyze objectives, products, suppliers, resources and the operating model to understand the business.
We organize stages, timelines, costs and risks into a tailored plan for Brazil.
We connect clients with qualified professionals according to the needs identified.
We maintain an integrated view of project progress and emerging operational needs.
servicesText: A complete perspective for more confident decisions, from planning to execution.
services: Assess tax impacts according to activity, products and operating model, with specialist support.
Identify legal and corporate needs for the planned entry model and investments.
Plan funding sources, international payments, investments and currency conversion.
Connect suppliers, transport, imports, storage and distribution to the business model.
Identify staffing and operational needs, connecting HR, accounting and labor specialists.
Analyze target customers, competition, positioning, sales channels and product adaptation.
Identify investment, costs, timelines and risks that may affect implementation.
partners: Specialists are responsible for technical execution. Nordion integrates diagnosis, planning and coordination across disciplines.
differenceText: Instead of figuring out who to contact at every stage, you have a single point of reference throughout the process.
brazilTitle: Your company’s next chapter could start here.

scenarioText: A foreign footwear company wants to enter Brazil. Before planning implementation, we examine production, suppliers, imports, logistics, target customers, sales channels, investment and financial flows. Each decision reflects the specific business model.
scenarioAnswer: That is where we come in.
scenarioNote: An illustrative scenario to explain our approach.
aboutTitle: Brazil does not have to be a barrier to your expansion.
aboutText: Nordion began in September 2026 as an academic project by seven Accounting students at UFJF, proposed by Professor Rodrigo Vieira in Principles of Administration II. The concept connects strategic intelligence and local specialists to support foreign companies in Brazil.
ctaTitle: Ready to make Brazil your next market?
ctaText: Understand the first steps to establishing your operation in the country.
footerText: Connecting your global ambition with the possibilities of the Brazilian market.

whoText: We are seven Accounting students who brought different perspectives together to develop a consultancy for entering and expanding in Brazil. Our approach starts with understanding each business and connects planning, Brazilian market context and specialists.
